notes.title: The Plague Doctor of Wippra wins Best Story at the GDD Indie Awards!
notes.content:
At the end of the GermanDevDays, the annual GDD INDIE AWARD is awarded. I am happy to announce that [i]The Plague Doctor of Wippra[/i] won the category [i]Best Story[/i]! :) The other nominees were [i]Chained Echoes[/i] and [i]Sonority[/i].

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/41519729/025d0304906916e84c5ab65b8e5c455f5c9654b3.png[/img]

Volker Ritzhaupt, CEO of my publisher Application Systems Heidelberg represented me at the award ceremony in Cologne and received the prize.

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/41519729/4248d476c6ad27d3c739c6d1e8781910ed630090.png[/img]

The stylish award - in the spirit of German oddities - will soon adorn my workplace in Berlin. An update will follow ;)

If you want to support my work and like my game I would really appreciate a review. Thanks a lot!

- Alex

notes.title: Help us reach 50 reviews!
notes.content:
Hi, everyone!

It is a about a month now, that The Plague Doctor of Wippra is released and I am really happy about the support and nice reviews we got.

We are so close to reach 50 reviews! Which is an important milestone because it switches the "Positive" rating to a "Very Positive" rating - that would be awesome! It also increases the visibility of the game on Steam and helps us a lot!

[b]In order to achieve 50 reviews we need your support![/b]


[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/41519729/b52a12ea47ad56025704bfc697ecbfe7d43cfd72.png[/img]


[b]If you enjoyed playing The Plague Doctor of Wippra, please take the time and write a review![/b]

Every review helps to increase the visibility on the platform and helps me do what I like most: making more games!

Thank you! :)

- Alex

notes.title: Available now!
notes.content:
Hi, everyone!

I am happy to announce that The Plague Doctor of Wippra is released! :)

I started development a year ago and have spent almost every day since then drawing the graphics, writing the text and dialogue, and making the game.

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/41519729/bb319509793c5433676af90b2c6feda0b1e8c662.png[/img]

Now you can buy The Plague Doctor of Wippra!

https://store.steampowered.com/app/1811740/The_Plague_Doctor_of_Wippra/


I am very excited to read your review and hear your feedback! :)

Thank you for your interest and thank you to everyone who supported me during the development!

- Alex
